description: This file defines the 'Protection' class used for managing sheet protection settings within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes constants for algorithms, properties for various protection options, and methods for handling password hashing, validation, and protection state checks.

classes.name: Protection
classes.description: Represents the protection settings for a worksheet, including password management, protection options, and state checking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the Protection class.

methods.name: isProtectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if any protection feature or password is enabled for the sheet.

methods.name: getSheet
methods.description: Returns whether the sheet protection is enabled.

methods.name: setSheet
methods.description: Enables or disables sheet protection.

methods.name: getObjects
methods.description: Returns whether objects are locked during protection.

methods.name: setObjects
methods.description: Sets whether objects are locked during protection.

methods.name: getScenarios
methods.description: Returns whether scenarios are protected.

methods.name: setScenarios
methods.description: Sets whether scenarios are protected.

methods.name: getFormatCells
methods.description: Returns whether cell formatting is locked.

methods.name: setFormatCells
methods.description: Sets whether cell formatting is locked.

methods.name: getFormatColumns
methods.description: Returns whether column formatting is locked.

methods.name: setFormatColumns
methods.description: Sets whether column formatting is locked.

methods.name: getFormatRows
methods.description: Returns whether row formatting is locked.

methods.name: setFormatRows
methods.description: Sets whether row formatting is locked.

methods.name: getInsertColumns
methods.description: Returns whether inserting columns is locked.

methods.name: setInsertColumns
methods.description: Sets whether inserting columns is locked.

methods.name: getInsertRows
methods.description: Returns whether inserting rows is locked.

methods.name: setInsertRows
methods.description: Sets whether inserting rows is locked.

methods.name: getInsertHyperlinks
methods.description: Returns whether inserting hyperlinks is locked.

methods.name: setInsertHyperlinks
methods.description: Sets whether inserting hyperlinks is locked.

methods.name: getDeleteColumns
methods.description: Returns whether deleting columns is locked.

methods.name: setDeleteColumns
methods.description: Sets whether deleting columns is locked.

methods.name: getDeleteRows
methods.description: Returns whether deleting rows is locked.

methods.name: setDeleteRows
methods.description: Sets whether deleting rows is locked.

methods.name: getSelectLockedCells
methods.description: Returns whether selection of locked cells is permitted.

methods.name: setSelectLockedCells
methods.description: Sets whether selection of locked cells is permitted.

methods.name: getSort
methods.description: Returns whether sorting is allowed.

methods.name: setSort
methods.description: Sets whether sorting is allowed.

methods.name: getAutoFilter
methods.description: Returns whether auto filter is enabled.

methods.name: setAutoFilter
methods.description: Sets whether auto filter is enabled.

methods.name: getPivotTables
methods.description: Returns whether pivot tables are protected.

methods.name: setPivotTables
methods.description: Sets whether pivot tables are protected.

methods.name: getSelectUnlockedCells
methods.description: Returns whether selection of unlocked cells is permitted.

methods.name: setSelectUnlockedCells
methods.description: Sets whether selection of unlocked cells is permitted.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the hashed password.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets a password with optional pre-hashed input.

methods.name: setHashValue
methods.description: Sets the password directly as a hashed value.

methods.name: generateSalt
methods.description: Generates a new salt string.

methods.name: getAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns the current hashing algorithm.

methods.name: setAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the hashing algorithm by name.

methods.name: setAlgorithmName
methods.description: Sets the hashing algorithm name.

methods.name: getSalt
methods.description: Returns the salt used for hashing.

methods.name: setSalt
methods.description: Sets the salt value.

methods.name: setSaltValue
methods.description: Sets the salt value.

methods.name: getSpinCount
methods.description: Returns the number of hash iterations.

methods.name: setSpinCount
methods.description: Sets the number of hash iterations.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a given password against the stored hash.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the Protection instance.
